visualize_densepose_vertex_outputs: visualize DensePose CSE vertex predictions on an image using the DensePoseOutputsVertexVisualizer class
visualize_densepose_texture_outputs: visualize DensePose predictions with texture atlas mapping using the DensePoseOutputsTextureVisualizer class
get_xyz_vertex_embedding: get a cached normalized vertex embedding map for a given mesh name and device
get_texture_atlases: parse a JSON string of mesh name to texture atlas paths and load the atlases
generate_image_with_texture: generate a textured image by mapping UV coordinates from a mesh onto a texture atlas
